title: Fastify v5 upgrade: a claim challenged against frozen upstream evidence
integrationContext: We currently run a Fastify v4 application on Node.js 18 inside a Linux container. The application contains reply.redirect(301, url) calls. We intend to upgrade to Fastify v5.0.0. No other runtime, API, build, packaging, installation, deployment or operational configuration details have been supplied.

challenge.explanation: I claim the runtime NEEDS_CHANGE conclusion is wrong: Fastify v5.0.0 still supports our current Node.js 18 runtime, so no runtime upgrade is necessary. Please evaluate this compatibility claim against the frozen upstream documentation.

notice: The environment is a synthetic test scenario. Both actors are project-controlled test wallets. The challenge deliberately makes a claim contradicted by the migration guide; results are recorded from actual validator execution, not prescribed by this preset. Advisory text review only: no installation, software execution, security certification, real users or payments.
